about: OEM plug data for the connector atlas. Face views are cropped from the 1993 TIS EWD pages shipped in the st185-celica-repair-manual app (extract_faces.py). Housing/terminal PNs are filled only when matched; rm_candidates points at the Toyota Wire Harness Repair Manual RM1022E housing-shape pages with the same cavity count (shape still to be confirmed by eye). page = PDF page of the circuit file inside the app; printed = number printed on the sheet.

jb1.title: J/B No.1 - LH kick panel junction block
jb1.sub: Factory box KEPT. We splice the factory leads of plugs 1F / 1H / 1I.

ie1.title: IE1 - engine room main wire to cowl wire joint (LH kick panel)
ie1.sub: Engine-room main REMOVED. We tap the cowl-side leads of IE1.

rb2.title: R/B No.2 - LH kick panel relay block position
rb2.sub: Relay block REMOVED; its factory leads stay in the loom.

rb4.title: R/B No.4 - RH kick panel relay block position
rb4.sub: Relay block REMOVED; its factory leads stay in the loom.

jb3.title: J/B No.3 - behind the combination meter
jb3.sub: OEM junction block KEPT; we tap plug 3B.

ig2.title: IG2 - engine wire to cowl wire joint (under the ECU)
ig2.sub: Engine-side wire removed. We tap the cowl-side leads of IG2.

ie1:IE1.caption: IE1  (both halves; cowl side = our taps)
